# Independent audit of two exact convex-partition obstructions

Audited independently by the depth/Helly route:

1. `candidate b5f24b03b630e2b0`;
2. `candidate d0cb383fd9782a9f`.

Both mathematical arguments PASS. The two supplied Fraction verifiers
also pass. Neither note asserts a failure of OC or of the simultaneous
convex partition realization theorem.

## 1. Every minimum-variance partition of the four-fiber rectangle

For C=[-1,2]x[0,1], the source mass and base moment are 4 and 2. The
pointwise integer inequality j^2>=j forces every minimum-base-variance
positive target to be 0 or 1. With at most two positive classes, mass and
moment conservation force precisely mass 2 at each. The exhibited cap
partition shows that the value 2 is actually attained.

The ambient-overlap repair is necessary and correct. If the convex
intersection of the two closed pieces had ambient interior, its projected
interior would contain no integer, since every intermediate section of
a convex body is a positive-length interval. Its entire projection must
therefore lie in one closed unit gap. Every split integer fiber belongs
to that projection, so at most two adjacent fibers can be split. Their
two masses satisfy integer total-mass and first-moment equations; the
adjacent-base determinant is one, forcing both masses to be integers.
The mass-two, moment-two piece would then occupy exactly the full fibers
at 0 and 2. Convexity forces the intervening full fiber at 1 as well,
contradicting its mass. Thus the two ambient interiors are disjoint.

Separation now legitimately applies. Exhaustion of all C and closedness
force each side of the separating line to be exactly its cap of C,
including all points on the line. A vertical separator cannot give
the required mass-two, moment-two source: the only possible two-fiber
prefix/suffix moments are -1 and 3. Nonvertical cap sources with the
prescribed moments are uniquely selected by their continuous orientation:
the integral of the affine score against indicator-minus-competitor is
nonnegative pointwise, and equality forces the same source a.e.

The two orientations have means (1,7/10), (1,3/10); their complementary
means are (0,3/10), (0,7/10). All four bad cap masses are 9/10, giving
normalized depth at most 9/40. The displayed threshold gaps are at least
1/5 on ALL of C, so zero outside-piece contribution is exact, not merely
a claim about an average or selected fibers. The nonminimal partition's
point (1,1/2) has original depth exactly 3/8 by its symmetric mass-three
subproduct and its explicitly attaining cap. Scope is therefore correct.

## 2. At least one piece cannot have local continuous Grunbaum depth

For fibers [0,1],[0,2],[0,3], total mass and base moment are 6 and 8.
One integer-mean class is impossible. Of the possible two distinct integer
means, {0,1} cannot average to 4/3; {0,2} would leave the middle fiber
unassigned because both means are projection-extreme. Thus the means
are 1 and 2, with forced masses 4 and 2.

The mean-two piece has zero mass below base 2. Closedness forces the
mean-one piece to retain the complete fibers at bases 0 and 1. At base 2,
its length-one interval and the other's length-two interval are a null-
overlap exhaustive partition of [0,3], so the smaller interval is exactly
[0,1] or [2,3]. This classification uses only actual fiber traces and
does not assume a separating ambient hyperplane.

The corresponding mean-one centroids are (1,3/4) and (1,5/4). Their
displayed tilted caps capture lengths (1,3/4,0), respectively, giving
local mass 7/4 and normalized local depth at most 7/16<1/2. The very
same caps have zero mass in the other piece. Both trace cases have the
explicit convex halfspace-partition realizations stated in the note.

The original all-cap formula at (1,1) has mass in [2,4] for every upward
normal; the opposite cap has complementary mass and vertical closed caps
have masses 3 or 5. An upward cap attains 2. The original depth is exactly
1/3, so this is not an OC counterexample; 7/4 also exceeds its OC absolute
target 3/2. All endpoint and closed-cap conventions are retained.

## 3. Exact checks run

    work/math-venv/bin/python supporting computation verify_all_minimum_variance_partition_obstruction.py
    work/math-venv/bin/python supporting computation verify_two_piece_local_grunbaum_partition_obstruction.py

Both return PASS. The geometric completeness arguments above were checked
separately; they are not consequences of the short arithmetic scripts.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
